scientific_assessment.operation: Regulate adipose-derived endocrine signalling and local glucocorticoid responsiveness to communicate metabolic state and coordinate hormonal adaptation.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Defined oral DHA changed the circulating adiponectin signal in selected human contexts. This endocrine-response proposition does not claim local secretion, synthesis or receptor engagement.

dietary_exposure.statement: Oral DHA was administered in a defined re-esterified-triglyceride supplement; enriched-oil and mixed fish-oil exposures are assessed separately. Existing food composition establishes dietary presence, not trial equivalence.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing food composition records and structured DHA edges cover multiple animal foods and algal oil; source, material, preparation and presence records were examined separately. Unmapped existing composition observations stay provisional. No new food or food-effective quantity is invented; trial formulations are not treated as equivalent to ordinary foods.

scientific_assessment.scope: Circulating adipose-derived endocrine signal modulation, not local production or physiological/clinical improvement.

relationships.biological_role: Defined oral DHA exposures can modulate circulating adiponectin, an adipose-derived endocrine signal.
relationships.dietary_input_note: Type B regulatory relationship; no dietary necessity, brain efficacy or ordinary-food intervention equivalence.
relationships.limitation: Admission concerns a circulating hormone response in studied supplement/enriched-oil contexts. It does not establish adipose secretion, receptor sensitivity, universal benefit, ordinary-food efficacy or a food-effective dose. Mixture and carrier effects are not attributed to DHA alone; DHA-specific attribution uses the separate DHA-versus-EPA trial.
relationships.qualification: Type B regulatory relationship; no dietary necessity, brain efficacy or ordinary-food intervention equivalence.

evidence.limitations: DHA presence is supported by the authorised algal-oil specifications on this page. The amount is formulation-specific and is not established as one value for algal oil in general.

observations.label: DHA
observations.notes: Often comparable to EPA in Pacific species; check species-specific compositional tables.
observations.source_note: DHA varies widely by species and preparation. USDA FoodData Central for "Mollusks, oyster, Pacific, cooked, moist heat" (FDC 174250; via MyFoodData: https://tools.myfooddata.com/nutrition-facts/174250/wt2) implies ~500 mg DHA per 100 g (0.425 g per 85 g). European flat oysters (Ostrea edulis) in the Danish FRIDA database are lower (~193 mg DHA per 100 g raw; Food ID 163: https://frida.fooddata.dk/food/163). Use as an indicative range.
